Camera pulling back progressively cuts off the fallen red and white pile by the lower frame edge.

caption: The video showcases an elaborate domino installation arranged on a wooden floor against a pale wall trimmed with a wood baseboard. Tall vertical columns of multicolored dominoes stand at the left, while a horizontal board displays a red, green, and blue zigzag pattern toward the center-right. A winding clear-plastic rail track snakes across the scene carrying several triangular clusters, and long rainbow-striped rows on the floor-left point toward it, each ending at a small tan wooden launcher. Two already-fallen piles of red and white dominoes rest along the bottom edge beneath a fixed watermark. Throughout the clip the camera slowly reframes the setup, pulling back and sliding so the left columns drift partly off the frame edge while a white domino structure at the right edge enters view. The standing arrangements remain intact, with no piece toppling or moving during the excerpt. As the view shifts, the fallen pile at the bottom is progressively cut off by the lower frame edge.
